articles.title: Panthers extend Jets’ winless streak to six
‘So gifted’: Tkachuk dishing assists at an historic rate for Panthers
Winnipeg Jets celebrate annual Pride Night Nov. 19

away.summary: The Jets are on a seven-game winless skid and have struggled to maintain consistency over full 60-minute efforts, often collapsing in stretches that lead to large deficits. Coach Scott Arniel has shuffled lines and emphasized mental mistakes, while the team hopes momentum from a late third-period rally against Tampa can carry into Florida. With several key injuries, Winnipeg is relying on its blue line to contribute more offensively and needs discipline to snap the slide.

home.summary: The Panthers enter on a strong note with a 5-1 win over Winnipeg, powered by Matthew Tkachuk’s historic assist pace and balanced scoring. They are dressing the same lineup as their previous two games and have depth despite injuries to key players like Barkov and Markstrom. Florida is poised to extend the Jets’ struggles with a disciplined, high-powered attack and strong special teams.
